description: List the dashboard's ready-made sequence templates: lifecycle emails for SaaS, ecommerce, content and offline businesses, and push-first journeys for mobile apps (trial to paid, billing issue recovery, cancellation save, paywall viewed but not converted, annual renewal reminder, expired win-back, lapsed users, new install onboarding). Each template lists its trigger event, continue condition, channels (push, in_app, email), channelStrategy (push_first_email_fallback means contacts reachable by push get push and in-app, everyone else gets email), quiet hours, frequency cap, attribution goal, required integration and steps. By default the list is filtered to the company's category (websiteType from get_company) with templates built for it first. Create one with create_sequence_from_template.

companyId.description: Company ID. Optional with a company-scoped key; required with a personal key that can access several companies.

websiteType.description: Category to list for. "company" (default) uses the company's own category, "all" lists every template.
